# Missing API Token Handling

The constructor of the GitHubGateway class raises a ForgeError if neither KC_GITHUB_TOKEN nor GITHUB_TOKEN is set. This could lead to failure in instantiation if the tokens are accidentally not provided.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/collectors/forge.py` — `knowledge_compiler.collectors.forge.GitHubGateway.__init__`
